name: Jeonbuk State (전북특별자치도)
verdict: The provincial government of Jeonbuk, South Korea (Jeonbuk State, 전북특별자치도), sponsoring in its own name; a South Korean provincial government with no record of serious abuses found.
note: Continuing Jeonbuk Hyundai uniform partner (province branding on the kit). Rating note: the sponsor is the provincial government itself; state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md), South Korea has no record in this data, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the province was found.
